purpose: Benchmarking of chronic kidney disease care between hospitals for our annual quality report: kidney function of the CKD population and uptake of SGLT2 inhibitors, which guidelines now recommend for kidney protection.
question: Per hospital, how many patients have chronic kidney disease, what is their mean eGFR, what share has an eGFR below 45 and what share is on an SGLT2 inhibitor?
definitions: Hospital = the data_holder of the patient record (Klinikum Nord, Klinikum Süd, Klinikum West).
Chronic kidney disease = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with N18.
Use the latest eGFR (LOINC 62238-1) per patient; the mean and the eGFR share are computed over patients with an eGFR value.
eGFR below 45 = latest eGFR value strictly below 45.

SGLT2 inhibitor = ATC code starting with A10BK, active on 31 December 2025 (start_date on or before that day and end_date empty or on or after that day); share computed over all patients with chronic kidney disease.
Report per hospital: patients with chronic kidney disease, patients with an eGFR value, mean eGFR (one decimal), % with eGFR below 45 (one decimal) and % on an active SGLT2 inhibitor (one decimal).
